messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate + p95 latency spike on hosted-inference-east-prod. Symptoms: sustained KV cache miss amplification after model rollout (quant v2.4). Trigger: 5xx spike, throughput drop. Runbook link: https://go/runbooks/inference-pager. Please ack and follow mitigation steps.

oncall-bot: Incident ID INC-20260316-89. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Initial p95 token latency 1.2s -> 3.8s, error rate from 0.1% -> 3.1%.

sam: taking this. looking at kvcache stats and batcher metrics now.

sam: quick dump from edge: 
```
2026-03-16T21:03:12Z INF kvcache: miss key=ctx:abc evictions=1243
2026-03-16T21:03:13Z WRN batcher: slow_enqueue ms=460
2026-03-16T21:03:13Z ERR model: quant_decode_timeout id=zk-21
```

sam: hypothesis: quantized model rollout increased decoding time, causing KV entries to pile up -> eviction cascade -> more misses -> higher latency. will try fast mitigations: reduce batch window, add capacity, and temporarily rollback to fp16 variant.

sam: mitigation commands I'm about to run: 
```
rctl scale pools inference-east -n +2
rctl config set /inference/batcher/batch_window_ms 40 -> 10
rctl deploy model redwood/llama-2:fp16 --target inference-east --force-pin
```

sam: running them now. will post status updates.

infra-bot: Scaling pool inference-east (+2 nodes) started by sam. Deployment to variant redwood/llama-2:fp16 initiated. Config update batch_window_ms -> 10 queued.

sam: batch window change applied, pool scale completed, model pin deploy in progress. preliminary metrics: p95 down from 3.8s -> 1.6s, errors dropping. monitoring dashboards: https://dash/redwood/inference-east

tara: thanks for the fast run, sam. I'll start the incident doc and schedule postmortem. tagging owners: sam (runtime remediation + rollback notes), leah (telemetry + alerts), mike (customer impact summary).

mike: heads up: customer impact summary so far — window 21:02-21:18 UTC. ~3,200 failed requests across hosted API, top affected customers: search-pro (500 failed), notes-app (320), internal smoke tests flagged. No data exfiltration. I'll prepare a customer email draft for CSM.

leah: created Jira: INF-5234 "KV cache eviction cascade after quant rollout" https://jira/redwood/browse/INF-5234. Adding triage checklist and linking dashboards.

leah: immediate follow-ups I'm owning: - add per-model quant / performance alert threshold - capture kv eviction rate per-prefix - add slow_enqueue SLO alert for batcher

tara: action items and owners (short): 
- Sam: write step-by-step rollback/mitigation runbook + gate for future quant rollouts (due: +48h).
- Leah: instrument per-prefix eviction telemetry + add alerts (due: +72h).
- Mike: customer impact summary + CSM coordination (due: +24h).
- Tara: schedule postmortem + publish incident timeline (due: +48h).

sam: I'll also add a small repro harness to stress quant decode path and KVs. plan to run on staging tomorrow and share findings.

mike: draft email for CSM: "we observed temporary degradation due to a model variant interaction with KV cache; mitigation applied; corrective actions planned." will post for review.

infra-bot: Deployment redwood/llama-2:fp16 -> inference-east completed. Health checks OK.

sam: monitoring shows stable performance for 40m post-mitigation. closing live pager. Will keep incident open for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260316-89: pager closed by sam at 2026-03-16T21:45:30Z. Postmortem required.

tara: scheduling postmortem for Thu 2026-03-18 16:00 PT (30m). Owner: tara. Calendar invite sent to eng-runtime, eng-oncall, eng-ml, product.

leah: adding longer-term remediations to INF-5234: - quantization compatibility tests in CI - KV cache eviction backpressure (soft-throttle) - tuning default batch_window based on seq length distribution

tara: thanks team. I'll publish the incident timeline and action tracker in the doc and link to INF-5234. Please add any missed notes to the thread.

mike: adding note: monitor any related increase in vendor-side queuing (cloud-networking) — may be correlated.

sam: final note — mitigation choices: scale + reduce batch window + pin fp16 variant. We should consider an automated rollback guard for rollout jobs if p95 > 2s or evictions spike > 500/min.

leah: created follow-up ticket INF-5235 for automated rollback guard and INF-5236 for quant regression CI harness.

tara: I'll capture owners and deadlines in the postmortem doc. closing thread for live mitigation; we continue tracking remediation in INF-5234/5235/5236. :lock:
